messages:
emma: Quick sync — experiment plan for persona-specific credit nudges + webinar tie-in. Goal: move trial -> active within 7 days. rough KPIs: 20% lift in day7 activation, CAC neutral. @jason @sara
jason: Love it. Which personas are we leaning into? devs, product teams, and platform? :thinking_face:
sara: yep. propose 3 buckets: hobby/dev, startup/product, enterprise/platform. different credit sizes and CTA flows. also run a control with baseline generic 100 credits.
mike: For enterprise we should route leads to AE queue if they hit >500 token usage in 48h. routing rule idea: usage >= 500 -> AE; else automated nurture.
emma: draft messaging snippet for startup/product: "Try Redwood with 200 free credits — ship features faster with low-latency inference. Join our product deep-dive webinar to see benchmarks." short link: https://redwood.ai/webinar
sara: A/B test subject lines: A) "200 credits — benchmark your app vs hosted" B) "See latency & cost benchmarks — free credits". track opens -> click -> redemption -> day7 activation.
jason: Need event names + UTM params. Suggest: utm_campaign=credit_persona_v1, utm_content={subject_variant}
ops-bot: reminder: ensure tracking events implemented: credit_granted, credit_redeemed, session_started, day7_active.
emma: onboarding flow idea: redemption -> 1: welcome email + quickstart template; 2: 24h nudge with prompt templates for common tasks; 3: invite to webinar on day 3 if still low usage.
mike: prompt template bundle for startups: onboarding prompt + chat example + embed snippet. Who owns templates repo?
sara: @jason can own creation. I'll write 3 short templates per persona by EOD Friday.
jason: i'll add routing rule PR and events to tracking board. can we set a guardrail: credits auto-expire after 14 days? reduces stale accounts.
emma: yes expire 14d. also add a canary: roll to 10% of new signups next Tue, then ramp.
sara: can we surface benchmark narratives on landing page? short bullets: "<20ms p50 on our hosted, 3x cost savings with batching" — need legal proof points
jason: i'll sync with infra for perf numbers. want to avoid absolute claims unless we have internal tests.
emma: final asks — 1) copy variants 2) prompt templates 3) tracking events + PR 4) routing rules 5) webinar registration page updated. owners: copy -> sara, templates -> jason, tracking -> mike, routing -> jason, webinar -> emma.
mike: noted. I'll prep monitoring dashboard: credit usage by persona + funnel conversion.
emma: thanks team! quick check-in tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
